extDescription.message: Tells the SaidKeep Windows app who is speaking in Google Meet, so transcript voices get real names.

popupLead.message: This extension tells the SaidKeep app, installed on your computer, who is speaking in Google Meet.

statusNoApp.message: The SaidKeep app is not open on this computer.

showBadge.message: Show the badge in Google Meet

badgeHint.message: The badge shows who the extension sees speaking and whether the app is connected.
